deviation: The reported total usage ceiling 32,768 tokens was written for in-session subagents and is infeasible with the Codex CLI, whose fixed per-call input overhead was measured. For this run the ceiling applies to CONTENT tokens: per call, content = reported input tokens minus the fixed overhead baseline (measure the baseline once per session as the input-token count of a minimal one-word prompt under the same flags, and record it) plus output tokens; ceiling 32,768 content tokens per candidate. Record both the raw reported usage and the content-token figure for every call. The owner authorised running these evaluations through the Codex subscription; this deviation changes a cost limit only and no accuracy criterion.
limitations: two published synthetic tasks; same model family interpreter and grader; same user no hard filesystem jail; zero-tool-event filter; requested model identity not independently verified
